fixtures.purpose: Exact symbol-target retrieval should keep the authority definition in the top authority band.
Diff-centered retrieval should anchor directly on changed spans and nearby tests.
Fallback parsing should degrade confidence and block autonomy rather than pretend to be exact.
Broad multi-file impact should remain explainable and review-oriented.
Python method/function name collisions should remain explicit and confidence-bounded.
Java normalize-call paths across similarly named utilities should stay explainable and ambiguity-aware.
Elixir aliased module and local function call surfaces should remain bounded under ambiguity.
Elixir def/defp/defdelegate extraction should keep private targets resolvable as authority units.
ExUnit-targeted retrieval should stay plan-safe and preserve test ranking metadata.
TypeScript exact symbol targeting should keep authority units in top_authority with high confidence.
TypeScript broad path targeting should remain ambiguity-aware and plan-safe.
JavaScript exact symbol targeting should keep authority units in top_authority with high confidence.
JavaScript broad path targeting should remain ambiguity-aware and plan-safe.
Lua exact symbol targeting should keep authority units in top_authority with high confidence.
Lua broad path targeting should remain ambiguity-aware and plan-safe.

Zig broad path targeting should remain ambiguity-aware and plan-safe.
HTML exact symbol targeting should keep document units in top_authority with high confidence.
HTML broad selector targeting should remain ambiguity-aware across markup and stylesheet context.
CSS exact selector targeting should keep selector units in top_authority with high confidence.
CSS broad selector targeting should remain ambiguity-aware across selectors and custom properties.
Broad shorthand-style retrieval should avoid vendored tree-sitter noise and remain source-oriented.
Suspected symbol hints should recover source authority units without promoting vendored lexical matches.
Clojure exact symbol targeting keeps the namespace-qualified definition in the top authority band.
An unqualified Clojure symbol that also names a test must resolve to the definition; the same-named test is pulled in as a related-test neighbour rather than displacing it.

Java exact symbol targeting keeps the package-and-class-qualified method in the top authority band. The expected unit id carries the arity and signature key on purpose: that identity is the lane's Variant C decision, and a change to it should break this fixture loudly.
Two same-name overloads in one class are both kept in the top authority band, distinguished by arity in their unit ids rather than merged into one identity.
Python exact symbol targeting keeps the module-qualified function in the top authority band and pulls in the module it calls.
An unqualified Python symbol that names both a module function and a class method reports target ambiguity and keeps both candidates rather than silently choosing one.
Elixir exact symbol targeting keeps the module-qualified function in the top authority band, with the arity in its unit id.
A function reachable both through a defdelegate and through the module it delegates to keeps both definitions in the top authority band rather than collapsing them.
